description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DModel" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectRequest" name="Sketches and project request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Satisfaction" name="Satisfaction confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Start_SendRequest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send sketches and request a project" messageRef="Message_ProjectRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Start_SendRequest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_SendRequest_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL model" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_SendRequest_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_CheckSatisfaction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSatisfaction" name="Check whether satisfied with the result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_CheckSatisfaction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_CheckSatisfaction_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_CheckSatisfaction_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Satisfied_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSatisfaction" name="Confirm satisfaction to the artist" messageRef="Message_Satisfaction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Satisfied_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Confirm_ChooseColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Confirm_ChooseColor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Is the color at home?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Under100_AddToList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_NotUnder100_MergeStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Put color on the shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Under100_AddToList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_AddToList_MergeStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeStock" name="Continue with color in stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_AddToList_MergeStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NotUnder100_MergeStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_MergeStock_MergeColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order the color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_OrderColor_MergeColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeColor" name="Continue with plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_MergeStock_MergeColor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_OrderColor_MergeColor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_MergeColor_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and G-code">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_MergeColor_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Split_HeatPrinter</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Split_GenerateGCode</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat the bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:documentation>The printer continuously sends status during heating.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Split_HeatPrinter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_HeatPrinter_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGCode" name="Generate G-code from the STL file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Split_GenerateGCode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_GenerateGCode_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer and G-code ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_HeatPrinter_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_GenerateGCode_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_PreparationJoin_Print</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_PreparationJoin_Print</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C_Print_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Print_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Start_SendRequest" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_SendRequest_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ReceiveSTL_CheckSatisfaction" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_CheckSatisfaction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_CheckSatisfaction_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSatisfaction" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Satisfied_Confirm" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendSatisfaction">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NotSatisfied_Changes" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_SendChanges_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Confirm_ChooseColor" sourceRef="Task_SendSatisfaction" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_ChooseColor_InStock" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_InStock_CheckAmount" name="Color at home" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NotInStock_Order" name="Color not at home" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_CheckAmount_Under100" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Under100_AddToList" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NotUnder100_MergeStock" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_MergeStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_AddToList_MergeStock" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_MergeStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_MergeStock_MergeColor" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeStock" targetRef="Gateway_MergeColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_OrderColor_MergeColor" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_MergeColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_MergeColor_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeColor" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Split_HeatPrinter" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Split_GenerateGCode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGCode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_HeatPrinter_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_GenerateGCode_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGCode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_PreparationJoin_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ProjectRequest" name="Receive sketches and project request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Start_CreateProject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProjectRequest" messageRef="Message_ProjectRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Start_CreateProject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_CreateProject_SendSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send STL model" messageRef="Message_STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_CreateProject_SendSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_SendSTL_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback" messageRef="Message_Changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_SendSTL_ReceiveFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback" name="What is the customer feedback?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_ReceiveFeedback_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Changes_Revise</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Satisfied_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseModel" name="Make the requested changes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Changes_Revise</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProjectComplete" name="Project complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A_Satisfied_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Start_CreateProject" sourceRef="Start_ProjectRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_CreateProject_SendSTL" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_SendSTL_ReceiveFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_ReceiveFeedback_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Changes_Revise" name="Changes requested" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback" targetRef="Task_ReviseModel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">changesRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Satisfied_End" name="Customer satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback" targetRef="End_ProjectComplete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerSatisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_Revise_SendSTL" sourceRef="Task_ReviseModel" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProjectRequest" name="Sketches and project request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_ProjectRequest" messageRef="Message_ProjectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Satisfaction" name="Satisfaction confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendSatisfaction" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_Satisfaction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Continuous status updates during heating" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
